decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template sits close to the core offer and costs little to keep online, so the option is still worth holding while demand from shop agencies is unclear.
The responsive website template is cheap to carry and supports the hosting business, though it was only mentioned briefly and the firm holds many other options, so there is some risk it lapses.
Premium support builds directly on the firm's 24/7 expert support strength and creates recurring revenue, so its value is likely to be realized at modest extra cost.
The version management tool has a page of its own and builds on the platform tools that reduce operational work for agencies, which makes it a strategic option worth continued investment.

The GDPR data processing contract tool is far from the core offer, but it is presented on its own page, demand after the 2018 GDPR rules is still uncertain, and an online tool costs little to maintain, so keeping the option open is justified for now.
